steps.title: The Workshop
steps.setting: The Galactic C's workshop, a converted passenger galley. Chrome, teal vinyl, a cassette deck playing low, tools everywhere. Through a porthole: Lumenhaven, a neon-lit planet ringed with orbital stations. Ashe, sleeves rolled, has his arm inside an open wall panel. Dust sits on a crate flipping a credit chip.

choice.text: Maybe I want to go back.
I'll charm her. Princesses love me.

beats.narrate: Morningwake: white enamel and a gold sunburst. One corner is chipped, and black shows through.
The ship jolts. Every light flickers. Through the porthole, streaks of orange: orbital battery fire.

steps.title: The Plan
steps.setting: The cockpit: wraparound windows, the planet filling the view, defence stations glittering in orbit, orange tracers. Deena comes skidding in, wrench in hand, coral hair half-down.

choice.text: What if we took the station?

beats.narrate: A heavy CLANG. The whole ship lurches sideways. Red emergency lights flood the cockpit.
ALTITUDE 9,000 m. It drops every combat round and every step between fights. It won't fail you; it decides how well Ashe lands.

steps.title: The Lounge
prompts: The timeline at the top shows who acts next. Faster units act more often.
Move up to your Move range, then take one action. Seats give half cover.
The Breacher hits hardest. Dropping one enemy fast beats wounding three.
Attacks from the side or back hit harder.
Dust and Ashe can Mend: a small Eternity heal.

beats.narrate: A short run aft down a tilted corridor; the floor is at an angle now. Cut to the cargo hold.

steps.title: The Cargo Hold
prompts: Deena is very fast; she'll often act before enemies do. She's also brittle. Keep her in cover.
Deena carries one Stun Grenade. Save it; you'll want it later.
Pass Turn: Deena can give her turn to an ally, who acts immediately (cooldown 3). Try passing to K'saabu before the troopers spread out.
K'saabu is slow, but every cannon shot hits a 3x3 area. Here there's nothing to protect, so unleash him.
In many fights, civilians and delicate equipment will be in the blast. Move them first, or don't fire.
K'saabu can raise a personal shield and Taunt enemies into attacking him instead of Deena.

beats.narrate: Ashe and Dust drop into the hold from a ceiling hatch.

steps.title: The Embarkation Bay

intro.narrate: The crew crouches behind the check-in desk, looking through the open bulkhead at six boarders. Their uniforms match. Nothing else does: every weapon is different, battered, half-repaired.

prompts: Any character can Search as an action. Higher Perception spots more. Deena's Perception is very high.
The Sergeant's Deflector reflects ranged and AoE attacks fired into it. While it's up, K'saabu's cannon is dangerous near him. Think about how to separate him from his squad.

fail_hints.reflected: Firing into the Deflector bounced the shot straight back. Search first, or separate the Sergeant from his squad.
fail_hints.deena: Deena went down in the open. Keep her in cover, and let K'saabu Taunt.

beats.narrate: On the Sergeant's body: under the Unity collar, a tattoo of a candle with an open mouth, and a data tape. Dust plays a second of it: the Galactic C's exact flight plan, filed privately with the Srov two days ago.
Ashe sprints for the cockpit. Deena is sitting on the floor against a luggage cart, pistol in her lap, staring at the body of the trooper she shot.
He helps her up. K'saabu lumbers over and wraps both of them in an enormous, damp hug, lifting them off the floor.
The ship's nose drops. The roar becomes a scream. The city's neon blooms out of the clouds, impossibly fast. The screen floods white.

steps.title: The Warehouse
steps.setting: Morning-dark in the Lowlight. Rain. The Galactic C is embedded nose-first in the side of a warehouse, three storeys up, steaming, neon signs flickering around the hole. The 'hampion' on the hull is lit by a pink holo-advert for noodles.

beats.narrate: Below, a door bangs open. A short, furious woman in a neon raincoat, Mama Quell, glares up at them, a cleaver in one hand and an invoice already in the other.
